messages:
alex: heads-up — travelling delay, need primary coverage swap for tonight 22:00-02:00. I can do 20:00-22:00 but my flight now lands late. sorry for the short notice :airplane:

maria: I can pick up 22:00-23:30 if that helps. can do warm handoff for first 15m. :thumbsup:

sam: I can take 23:30-02:00. prefer a short overlap so I can catch up on any active tickets.

jordan: suggestion: do a 10m dual-handoff at 22:00 and a quick pager dry-run to validate routes. also, update the rotation doc after we confirm. runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-primary-handovers

alex: thanks — dual-handoff sounds good. jordan can you post the handoff checklist here? also will trigger incident-bot dry-run if everyone's ok.

jordan: copy. checklist (short):
1) Primary updates 'current-incident' pinned msg + summary
2) Share any active pager/PD escalation links
3) Confirm secondary coverage + contact method
4) Run quick synthetic page to primary (dry-run)
5) Verify monitoring dashboards & recent alerts

jordan: putting the minimal takeover steps inline: ```
- confirm pagerduty rotation is set to team-primary
- run `curl -X POST https://pager.test/api/fire?page=primary-test --data '{"note":"dry-run"}'`
- check #incidents for bot post and look for response ack
```

maria: ack on checklist. i'll be at my desk at 21:50 for prep.

sam: ack. i'll be ready for the 23:20 shadow handoff so i get 10m overlap.

incident-bot: scheduled_paging_test: paging rotation "team-primary" at 2143658800 (in ~100s). TYPE=DRY-RUN. No automatic escalations.

alex: perfect — running through quick customer-impact note: nothing active right now besides an elevated latency alert on embeddings-prod that is in monitoring but no pagers fired. leaving note: "embeddings-prod: elevated p50 p99, no customer-facing errors, monitoring runbook linked"

maria: saw the latency alert — thx for the note. i'll verify dashboards during the handoff and mark whether it needs escalation.

incident-bot: paging_test_result: sent pager to user maria (primary) at 2143658800. response: no ack required for dry-run. log: test-id=pt-2143658800

maria: got the test. saw bot message in #incidents. all good.

jordan: all confirmed. @alex i've updated the rotation doc with the swap note and tagged the schedule owner.

alex: thank you all — confirmed coverage: alex 20:00-22:00, maria 22:00-23:30 (primary), sam 23:30-02:00 (primary). jordan helped facilitate dual-handoff and ran dry-run. i've updated calendar & pager schedule. appreciate the quick help :relieved:

sam: noted. ping me earlier if embeddings spikes again.

maria: i'll leave a short handoff summary pinned at 22:10 with dashboard links and next steps.

alex: done — leaving now. safe handoff everyone. :wave:
